top_signals.title: ‘Standing on one leg’: IMF chief warns about global economy as AI circular financing hits $1 trillion
top_signals.summary: Kristalina Georgieva says circular financing among AI companies has grown to just over $1 trillion, two-thirds of it debt, as investor enthusiasm cools
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump says he may meet North Korea’s Kim in China as top regime official visits Moscow
top_signals.summary: The U.S. leader's remarks came as Russia said President Vladimir Putin had met with Jo Yong Won, a close confidant of Kim Jong Un, in Moscow.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Betterment CEO Sarah Levy on Plus Debut, New IRA Options
top_signals.summary: Betterment CEO Sarah Levy discusses the company's newly announced Betterment Plus program, which brings together human guidance, individual stock trading, lending and partner products, and IRA custody. She speaks with Romaine Bostick and Vonnie Quinn on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: First permanently assigned F-15EXs touch down at Kadena Air Base
top_signals.summary: Kadena Air Base received their first permanently assigned F-15EX Eagle IIs, becoming the first installation abroad and second Air Force location to field the jet.
